card.name: Ranking or enumerating words starting a point
card.fires_on: Words that introduce one item among several, such as most, one, another, key, crucial, alternative, at the start of a clause before a noun like problem, option, effect or group.

modes.label: Superlative or key-importance word
modes.description: Words like most, crucial or key that rank a noun before it.

modes.description: One or Another starting a sentence to introduce a problem, option or group.
modes.example: << One>> problem here is that the aim of the

modes.label: Alternative item
modes.description: Words like alternative or another that introduce a different option.
modes.example: an<< alternative>> dose is 500 mg once

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese words for 'most important', so it seems to steer away from superlative-importance words in that language.
card.plain: It fires on words like 'one', 'another' or 'most' that begin to single out one item from a set.
